tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground: hero, scenes, footer. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `gold`, `gold-hi`.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground, set against `surface-0`. Same text colors as `surface-0`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, form and the club medal. Text on it: `ink` 15.9:1, `ink-muted` 7.2:1, `gold` 11:1.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Raised parts inside a panel: tab track, device bar, chip-off state. Text on it: `ink` 14.6:1, `ink-muted` 6.6:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-0` to `surface-3` (14.6–17.2:1). Also the label on burgundy fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, card bodies on `surface-0` to `surface-3` (6.6–7.8:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one accent. Eyebrows, numerals, links, icons, active tab, section accent words. Text on `surface-0` to `surface-3` at 10.1–11.9:1.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight gold: hover text, the lit city pin, the first stop of the gold gradient. Text on `surface-0` 16:1.

tokens.name: gold-brand
tokens.usage: Metal of the СРП logo, as printed on the brand book. Fills and dividers on dark; never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: gold-lo
tokens.usage: Decorative only: gradient tail, cover block, ghost pin glow. 4.0–4.4:1 on the surfaces, so never body text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (`gold` 10.9:1, `gold-hi` 14.8:1, the button gradient tail 5.4:1).

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: Header CTA fill and the card suit on illustrations; the only place the old site's red survives. Label on it: `on-burgundy`.

tokens.name: burgundy-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the burgundy button gradient. `on-burgundy` on it 6.8:1.

tokens.name: on-burgundy
tokens.usage: Label on `burgundy` (9.4:1) and `burgundy-hi` (6.8:1). An alias of `ink`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline: card and section edges. 1.5:1 on purpose, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised edge: featured card, ghost button, device frame. 3.1:1 on `surface-0`, 3.2:1 on `surface-2`.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and chips. 5.4:1 on `surface-0`, 5.0:1 on `surface-2`, 4.6:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 3px offset. 14.8–16:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: gold-wash
tokens.usage: 8% gold tint behind a hovered card or the active row. Text on it keeps the surface's colors.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success text on `surface-2` (10.5:1). Always with a sentence, never a bare green.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text and invalid hint on `surface-2` (8.2:1). Always with a sentence; pair with the invalid border.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Illustration only: hearts on playing cards, the LIVE dot. 3.4:1, so never text and never a control.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one H1 of the page, in `ink` with one phrase in the gold gradient. Break only at hyphens.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Откройте клуб СРП в вашем городе
styles.usage: Section title, max 22 characters per line, one gold accent phrase.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: Network numbers in the gold gradient, tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Counters and the hero stat row.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Готовый бренд, Лига городов и собственная IT-платформа.
styles.usage: The line under the H1, `ink` on `surface-0`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Клубы СРП объединены общим брендом и рейтингом.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Игроки соревнуются за рейтинг и статус.
styles.usage: Card bodies, club meta, form hints.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Label above a section title in `gold`. Set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tab or a field group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a rail; field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones and card gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside a small card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Padding inside a feature card; gap between a title and its body block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on phones.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags, the cookie bar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the lead form, the device frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tabs, city chips, search field.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Resting glow under the gold button. The only gold glow on a control.

tokens.name: shadow-form
tokens.usage: Lift of the lead form over the section ground.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: The CRM window: deep shadow with a faint gold halo.

gradient.note: Metal fills. Gradients run inside one metal, never across hues.

tokens.name: gold-metal
tokens.usage: Numerals and the accent phrase of a title, clipped to text. 6.3:1 or more on `surface-0` along its whole length.

tokens.name: gold-button
tokens.usage: Fill of the gold button, under `on-gold` text.

tokens.name: burgundy-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the burgundy header button, under `on-burgundy` text.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centred with a `space-5` gutter.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Fixed header height on desktop; 64px on phones.

tokens.name: map-ratio
tokens.usage: Width-to-height ratio of the Russia map (1480 × 770). Overlay pins and arcs share it.
